scenarios.name: step
scenarios.description: one trivial no-op step, no stream; no hooks, so the run stays in turbo mode (in-process fast path)

scenarios.name: stream
scenarios.description: one streaming step; no hooks, so the run stays in turbo mode (in-process fast path)

scenarios.name: hook + stream
scenarios.description: registers a hook before one step, which exits turbo mode (dispatch path)

scenarios.name: 1020 steps
scenarios.description: 1020 trivial sequential steps; STSO is measured between consecutive steps in the given step ranges, and WO is the whole-run overhead outside step bodies

scenarios.name: stream latency
scenarios.description: parallel reader/writer steps on a dedicated stream; SL is the in-deployment write->read propagation (readAt - writtenAt)

scenarios.name: stream overhead (text)
scenarios.description: writer streams 300 variable-length text token deltas paced at 100/s for 3s (a haiku-size LLM's token throughput) while a parallel reader drains the whole stream; SO is the end-to-end write+consume time beyond the 3s generation window (overhead/backpressure)

scenarios.name: stream overhead (structured)
scenarios.description: same workload as stream overhead (text), but each delta is an AI-SDK-style structured object ({ type: 'text-delta', id, text }) instead of a raw string, so the SO gap vs the text scenario is the added serialization cost

scenarios.name: retained stream (full)
scenarios.description: fresh reader replays all 1000 chunks from a closed retained stream; reports first retained chunk and full drain latency

scenarios.name: retained stream (resume)
scenarios.description: fresh reader resumes at chunk 900 of a closed 1000-chunk stream; reports first retained chunk and suffix drain latency

scenarios.name: 100 concurrent x 50 steps
scenarios.description: 100 workflows execute 50 sequential no-op steps each; reports makespan, per-run TTFS/duration, and aggregate logical step throughput
